name: Alice
summary: Curious girl whose changes in size and encounters with talking animals unsettle her sense of identity.

fields.label: Continuity
fields.value: Her clothes grow and shrink with her.

name: Alice's sister
summary: Reads beside Alice on the bank before Alice follows the Rabbit.

name: White Rabbit
summary: A hurried rabbit with pink eyes, a waistcoat and a pocket watch.

fields.label: Objects
fields.value: Watch; later white kid gloves and a fan

name: Mouse
summary: Swims in the pool, objects to talk of cats and dogs, and tells a tale.

name: Dodo
summary: Organizes the Caucus-race and arranges the distribution of prizes.

name: Duck
summary: Joins the company that comes ashore from the pool.

name: Lory
summary: Argues with Alice about age and authority.

name: Eaglet
summary: Objects to the Dodo using long words.

name: Crab
summary: Tells her daughter to take a lesson from the Mouse.

name: Young Crab
summary: Answers her mother sharply.

name: Magpie
summary: Leaves when Alice speaks of her cat.

name: Canary
summary: Calls her children away when Alice speaks of Dinah.

name: Rabbit-hole
summary: The passage Alice follows from the bank into a deep well.

fields.label: Setting
fields.value: Cupboards and shelves line the well

name: Hall of doors
summary: A long hall with locked doors and a small passage to a garden.

name: Pool of tears
summary: Alice swims in the tears she shed while very large.

fields.label: Setting
fields.value: Company gathers on the bank in Chapter III

name: Golden key
summary: A small key opens the tiny door into the garden.

name: DRINK ME bottle
summary: The labeled bottle makes Alice shrink.

name: EAT ME cake
summary: The small cake makes Alice grow very tall.

name: Rabbit's fan
summary: Fanning herself makes Alice shrink again.

name: Thimble
summary: Alice receives her own thimble as a prize.
